page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with a centred heading "ORATIO." and a centred verse heading "VERSVS XIX. ET XX." above the verse block. No marginal notes. The running head is at the top, the page number at the top left.

main_text.p: Cæterùm reliquias aliquas eiusdem gẽ-tis, secundum electionem gratiæ, à Deo conseruandas esse, prædixit Amos, cap. 9. 11. vti pofsideant reliduum Edom, & omnes nationes, hi super quos inuocatum est no-men meum, dixit Iehouah faciens istud. Solet enim Deus, pro sua infinita bonitate, etiam quum in reprobos animadvertit, ex-cerpere pios quosdam, velut primitias gẽ-tium.
main_text.head: ORATIO.
main_text.p: Domine Iesu Christe, Quum tantus iam sit Antichristianorum & impiorum Maho-metistarũ furor & fremitus, & falsi fratres in ipsa Ecclesiæ tuæ viscera grassentur: ora-mus te, vt nobis dexter adesse pergas, no-bisque tuam largiaris gratiam, vt infractis animis cum Dauide dicamus singuli: Deo fido, non timebo, quid faciat homo mihi? da vt te, qui es Iehouah exercituum, san-[?]ctificemus, vt ipse sis timor & pauor no-ster: ad gloriam tuam & Ecclesiæ tuæ de-fensionem, Amen.
main_text.head: VERSVS XIX. ET XX.

page.notes: The catchword "bunt" sits at the lower right, under the last line, completing "possidebunt". The page number at the top left is hard to read and may be "150". The word "sanctificemus" is partly obscured at the line end, so its first letters are doubtful. The running head is set in small capitals.
